newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to lower on overnight trading.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to lower on overnight trading.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open 0.05 cent down as the London market ambled lower on light fund selling.
The October contract closed Tuesday at 11.61 cents a lb, up 0.03 cent from Monday and traded in a range between 11.50 and 11.64 cents. The LIFFE October contract was $1.20 off at $324.
The New York market has been trading sideways over the last week-and-a-half with little fundamental news to affect the market one way or the other.
The long funds and and the short commercials appear to be squaring off with many traders believing the bias is toward a liquidation and lower prices.
Producer hedge selling from Brazil is expected to cap any rallies, analysts said.
In other news, Syria has tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment between September 20 and October 30.
